message: `|| true` turns any failure of the command before it into success and destroys the error signal; handle the failure explicitly, e.g. `|| echo ...`
help: handle the failure explicitly: `cmd || { echo 'cmd failed, continuing because ...' >&2; }`, or drop the `|| true`
notes: `|| true` hides the exit status the next step or the caller needs to know the work failed (REQ-KS-012)
